title: SRV-CTR-001 CreateRun Request
description: 1.1.0 relaxes parameter typing: parameters is an opaque object envelope whose shape is defined by the parameter schema of the template addressed by template_ref/template_version. The 1.0.0 schema bound parameters to news-search-parameters-1.0.0, which left Quant and per-Stage templates with no valid request form. This schema constrains only the top-level envelope; the Server does not runtime-validate against it (validation is delegated to the resolved template's ParameterSchemaRef), but the shape described here matches the implemented boundary.

parameters.description: Opaque parameter envelope. Its concrete shape (including per-Stage namespaces such as {"stages":{"<stage_code>":{...}}}) is owned by the parameter schema of the template addressed by template_ref/template_version and is validated at CreateRun time. This schema constrains only that parameters must be a JSON object.
